hint.text: Install Goodsurfing on your iPhone — get notified about messages and applications like from an app
hint.title: How to install on iPhone
hint.note: Requires iOS 16.4 or later. The installed site keeps its sign-in separately from Safari — sign in there once more. Membership is paid on the website as usual.

steps.share: In Safari, tap “Share” at the bottom of the screen (if you don't see it, tap “⋯” first)
steps.addToHome: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”
steps.add: Keep “Open as Web App” on, if there is such a switch, and tap “Add”
steps.open: Open Goodsurfing from the Home Screen, sign in and turn on notifications in “Messages”

page.title: Goodsurfing on your phone
page.description: How to install Goodsurfing on iPhone and Android: notifications about messages and applications, sign-in and membership payment — just like on the website.
page.lead: Messages from hosts and volunteers, applications and notifications — always at hand.
page.androidText: The Android app is coming soon. For now, open the website in your browser — message notifications work there too.
page.iphoneText: Add the website to your Home Screen — it will open like an app, without the address bar, and can send you notifications.
page.installed: You opened Goodsurfing from the Home Screen — you're all set. Turn on notifications in “Messages”.
page.notSafari: These steps are for Safari. If the site is open in another browser or inside an app, open goodsurfing.org in Safari.
